what_to_do: Collect passport, degree and marksheets, language proof, CV and other university-specific documents as scanned PDFs.
tip: Start with the documents your program page lists.

what_to_do: Write a program-specific SOP (1-2 pages): why this course, why this university, career plan.
tip: Mention specific modules or labs; avoid generic text.

what_to_do: Register on aps-india.de, pay INR 18,000, courier documents, receive digital certificate. Needed for the student visa and many applications.
tip: Start before the application window; check if the dMAT test applies to your field.

what_to_do: Create an account on the university portal (and uni-assist VPD if needed), upload documents and submit before the deadline.
tip: Submit at least 2 weeks early; deadlines are strict.

what_to_do: Check the portal and email regularly; respond quickly to document requests.
tip: Use the same email as the portal account.

what_to_do: Some programs ask for an aptitude test or interview; check the program page and your email after the deadline.
tip: TUM Informatics may invite applicants for a written test.

what_to_do: Decisions usually take several weeks after the deadline. Do not buy non-refundable tickets before admission and visa.
tip: Meanwhile prepare blocked account and visa documents.
